commands.name: ban
commands.description: Bans a user from the server. The user cannot rejoin until unbanned.

commands.name: kick
commands.description: Removes a user from the server. The user can later rejoin using an invite link.

commands.name: mute
commands.description: Prevents a user from interacting in the server for a specified duration.

commands.name: warn
commands.description: Sends a warn message to a user with a reason specified by moderators.

commands.name: purge
commands.description: Mass-deletes a specified number of messages from the current channel.

commands.name: info user
commands.description: Shows detailed information about a user, or yourself if no user is specified.

commands.name: play
commands.description: Plays a song from a specified provider, which defaults to YouTube.

commands.name: info server
commands.description: Shows detailed information about the server that you are currently in.
